name: OMathPhantom
description: Represents a phantom object, which has two primary uses: (1) adding the spacing of the phantom base without displaying that base or (2) suppressing part of the glyph from spacing considerations.
remarks: Use the OMathPhantom object to display the spacing of part of an equation without displaying it, or to remove the spacing for part of a glyph from spacing considerations.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified OMathPhantom object.

properties.name: E
properties.description: Returns an OMath object that represents the base of the specified equation object. Read-only.

properties.name: Show
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether the contents of a phantom object are visible. Read/write.

properties.name: ZeroWid
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether the width of a phantom object is ignored in the spacing of the layout. Read/write.

properties.name: ZeroAsc
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether the ascent of the phantom contents is ignored in the spacing of the layout. Read/write.

properties.name: ZeroDesc
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether the descent of the phantom contents is ignored in the spacing of the layout. Read/write.

properties.name: Transp
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether a phantom object is transparent. Read/write.

properties.name: Smash
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents that the contents of the phantom are visible but that the height is not taken into account in the spacing of the layout. Read/write.
